The decisive mistake was made by CorporateHistory_IPOs_MondayCom_Expert at step 5. It presented a comparison as verified fact even though its sources could not support it. The WSJ "company people" page it cited gives current leadership, not the team at the June 10, 2021 IPO, so the "IPO-time" list (Roy Mann, Eran Zinman, Eliran Glazer) was unsupported. The current list was also drawn from a third-party aggregator (Craft.co) and was incomplete. The expert then concluded that Oren Stern, Amit Mathrani, and Michal Aharon were the answer. Verification_Expert at step 6 repeated the conclusion without checking the sources, but the unsupported comparison originated at step 5.
